_why: THE STALL PROBE. U4's Validated by column has two halves; this item is the second one:
'stall -> oracle observed firing at least once'. The oracle-on-stall mechanism was built
and mutation-proven on work/u4oracle, but every firing it had ever produced came from a
CONSTRUCTED failure - a drill typing the same reason three times. This item is how a
runner is given a task it genuinely cannot converge on, so the rounds the detector reads
are real ones.
IT IS DELIBERATELY UNSATISFIABLE. test_trims_and_lowercases and
test_trims_and_preserves_case require different outputs for the same input; no pure
function passes both. Nothing is hidden from the runner - the tests are planted in the
workspace and are the only specification, as in every other item. The task is impossible,
which is what 'a task that will genuinely stall it' means. Inducing a stall by choosing an
impossible task is still a real stall; writing the stall STATE into a fixture would not be,
and this item does not do that - what it produces is real failing rounds from real
dispatches, and the detector is what decides whether they constitute a stall.
DO NOT MAKE IT PASSABLE. If someone repairs the contradiction, this stops being a stall
probe and silently becomes a second baseline item - and the phase's second half loses the
only fixture that can produce its evidence.
IT IS NOT IN quadrant.runners' COMPARISON. `quadrant.item` names u4-baseline; this item is
run explicitly with `--item u4-stall`. A comparison scored on an impossible task would
measure nothing about the quadrants.
task: The directory `stall-item/` in this workspace contains two files: `normalize.py`, which holds a stub `normalize(text)` that raises NotImplementedError, and `test_normalize.py`, which specifies exactly what `normalize` must do. Implement `normalize(text)` in `stall-item/normalize.py` so that every test in `stall-item/test_normalize.py` passes. Use only the Python standard library. Do NOT modify `stall-item/test_normalize.py`. Do NOT create or modify any file other than `stall-item/normalize.py`. When the implementation is complete, stop.
